test_title: PYST 19: SSC MTS - English (Held on: 22 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: english
question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution: The erroneously spelt word is '**Grownd**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • Among the given Options the incorrectly spelt word is '**Grownd**'. • Its correct spelling is '**Ground**'. • It means 'the solid surface of the earth'. (पृथ्‍वी की कठोर सतह) • *Example: He slipped off the ladder and fell to the **ground**.* • Thus, the correct answer is **Option 2.** **Correct Answer:__** *Grownd.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Growl**: (used about dogs and other animals) to make a low noise in the throat to show anger or to give a warning. (कुत्ते या अन्‍य जानवरों का) दूसरों पर ग़ुर्राना (ग़ुस्‍सा व्‍यक्त करने या चेतावनी देने के लिए) • **Groove**: a long deep line that is cut in the surface of something. किसी सतह पर गहराई में की गई रेखा के आकार की काट; खाँचा, नाली • **Grumble**: to complain in a bad-tempered way; to keep saying that you do not like something. खीझते हुए शिकायत करना; नापसंद होने की रट लगाए रखना; बुड़बुड़ाना 36:Tc95, The correct answer is '**Jubilation**'.
